description: The pie chart illustrates the time distribution for two components of the Paper Copilot system, with the total time broken into two segments. The largest segment, colored orange, represents 60.9 seconds, accounting for 69.92% of the total time. The second segment, colored blue, represents 26.2 seconds, which corresponds to 30.08% of the total time. The blue segment is visually separated from the orange segment, creating a slight gap between them. The labels "Efficient deployment" and the time values are clearly displayed within or adjacent to their respective slices, with the percentages provided in parentheses. The chart uses a simple color scheme and clear labeling to convey the proportion of time spent on each component.
